newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon trims McDonald's EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon trims McDonald's EPS view.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it trimmed its second quarter 1997 earnings estimate for McDonald's Corp to $0.64 a share from $0.66 a share.
-- said believes McDonald's will post a four percent drop in May U.S. same store sales, compared with Salomon's previous estimate for a gain of one percent.
-- said maintains the third quarter earnings estimate of $0.71 a share and maintains the fourth quarter estimate of $0.67 a share.
-- said maintains forward quarterly estimates "because of increasing confidence that the company's international operating momentum is accelerating."
-- said "We continue to believe that material price declines in McDonald's shares caused by a weak US business will ultimately, in hindsight, be viewed as a great buying opportunity."
